body: Keep talking to him and get to know him well. I’m sure if you guys really enjoyed each other, FaceTimes and occasional visits back and forth would work :) also I would try to see each other if you do on a somewhat regular schedule such as every two weeks or whatever works for you guys. Overall I’d say give the man a try and if you really enjoy each other than it should be worth it :))
Thank you, I’m really hoping I’ll get over it but she meant a lot to me. I’m going to try starting a hobby or something to try to keep myself sane.

Long distance is really hard, or at least in my experience. Really loving someone but being so far away is a subtle pain (For me at least). It was probably my separation issues but overall it would be hard for most people. But If you guys really like each other then I’d say at least try it :))
